title: Frank Critzer, Nazi agent killed at Giant Rock

tellings.quote: So uh this this structure under the rock where George Vanessa lived used to be owned by a Nazi called Frank Croitzer.

plain: The underground rooms beneath Giant Rock, a huge boulder in the California desert where George Van Tassel later lived and held UFO gatherings, are said to have first belonged to a Nazi named Frank Critzer, who was killed there. A philosopher named Jason Jorjani tells this, drawing on a work called Closer Encounters. He raises it to link a famous UFO site to a hidden Nazi past.
